question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (3) i.e.** 'illicit'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• '**Illicit**' is the most appropriate choice because it describes **something that is not legally permitted or authorized**, which matches the context of behaviours that are not sanctioned by law or society, especially in response to stress or emotional turmoil.
 
• **Illicit **(अवैध) - Not legally permitted or authorized; unlawful.
